description: Draft a starter llms.txt (Markdown: # name, > one-line summary, key page links, contact) from business details, to publish at the site root so AI agents get a curated summary. Use when a site has no llms.txt. Do NOT use for crawler access rules (use robots_txt_for_ai) or schema.org markup (use schema_jsonld_sample).

business_name.description: Business or site name used as the '# ' title, e.g. Reddy Plumbing.

contact_email.description: Optional contact email listed under '## Contact', e.g. hello@example.com.

description.description: One sentence on what you offer and for whom, used as the '> ' summary, e.g. 24/7 emergency plumbers serving Austin, TX.

key_pages.description: Optional important pages listed under '## Key pages'. Each needs title and url.

note.description: Optional short note shown after the link, e.g. Pricing and areas served.

name: llms_txt_draft

disclaimer.description: Informational disclaimer: crawler behaviour can change, verify against provider docs.

publish_at.description: Where to publish the file (site root, text/plain).

title: Draft llms.txt
